questions.question: When exports are higher than imports, it is known as a situation of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** trade surplus.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Trade Surplus:- **

 
 
• A trade surplus occurs when a country sells more goods and services to other countries than it buys from them.
 
• This means that money is flowing into the country from abroad.
 
• When exports are higher than imports, it is also known as a situation of Trade Surplus 
 
• A trade surplus can have a number of positive effects on an economy, such as boosting economic growth, creating jobs, and increasing the value of the country's currency.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trade Deficit:- **

 
 
• A trade deficit occurs when a country imports more goods and services than it exports.
 
• It is calculated by subtracting the value of a country's exports from the value of its imports.
 
• A trade deficit can be a sign of a strong economy, as it indicates that consumers have sufficient resources to purchase more goods than are produced domestically. 
 
 
 
• ** Fiscal Deficit:-**
 
 
• A fiscal deficit occurs when a government spends more money than it collects in revenue.
 
• It is calculated by subtracting total government revenue from total government expenditure.
 
• A fiscal deficit can be financed by borrowing money from domestic or foreign sources, or by printing money.
 
 
 
• **Revenue Surplus:-**
 
 
• A revenue surplus occurs when a government collects more revenue than it spends.
 
• It is calculated by subtracting total government expenditure from total government revenue.
 
• A revenue surplus can be used to pay down debt, invest in public goods and services, or provide tax cuts.

questions.question: A ________ balance of trade is one in which the value of domestic goods exported exceeds the value of foreign goods imported.
questions.solution:

• **Favorable balance of trade:-**

 
 
• A favorable balance of trade is one in which the value of domestic goods exported exceeds the value of foreign goods imported. This is also known as a trade surplus.
 
• A favorable balance of trade is generally seen as a sign of economic strength, as it means that the country is earning more from its exports than it is spending on its imports.
 
• A trade surplus can have a number of benefits for a country, including:
 
 
• **Increased economic growth**: When a country exports more goods than it imports, it is essentially injecting more money into its economy. This can lead to job creation and higher wages.
 
• **A stronger currency**: When a country has a trade surplus, the demand for its currency increases. This can lead to a stronger currency, which can make imports cheaper and exports more competitive.
 
• **Increased investment:** A trade surplus can attract foreign investment, as investors are more likely to invest in countries with strong economies.

• **It states that the amount of heat energy produced in a conductor is proportional to the square of the current flowing through it, the resistance of the conductor, and the time for which the current flows.**

• Joule's Law can be used to explain a variety of phenomena, such as the heating of electric wires, the operation of light bulbs, and the heating of food in a microwave oven.

questions.question: The average of six consecutive odd numbers is 68. What is the cube of the difference between the highest and the lowest numbers?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any n consecutive odd or even numbers, the difference between the highest and lowest number is always (n − 1) × 2.

Here, n = 6 numbers, so the Difference = (6 − 1) × 2 = 10.

The average value (68) does not affect the difference between the terms.

Required value = Cube of the difference = 10³ = 1000.

**∴ The correct answer is 1000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Average of 6 consecutive odd numbers = 68

For an even number of terms (6), the average lies exactly between the two middle terms.

⇒ Middle terms (3rd and 4th) = 68 − 1 and 68 + 1

⇒ 3rd term = 67, 4th term = 69

⇒ Full sequence of odd numbers: 63, 65, 67, 69, 71, 73

⇒ Lowest number = 63

⇒ Highest number = 73

⇒ Difference = 73 − 63 = 10

⇒ Cube of difference = 10³ = 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000

questions.solution:
**Given:**

In 4 h, a boat goes 12 km along the stream.

It covers 6 km against the stream in the same time.

**Concept: **

Speed = Distance / Time

**Solution:**

The speed of the boat along the stream = Distance / Time = 12 km / 4 h = 3 km/h.

The speed of the boat against the stream = Distance / Time = 6 km / 4 h = 1.5 km/h.

Speed of the boat in still water = (Speed along the stream + Speed against the stream) / 2

⇒ (3 + 1.5)/2 = 2.25 km/h

**Therefore, the speed of the boat in still water is 2.25 km/h.**
